question: Which team won the Durand Cup 2024 by defeating Mohun Bagan SG 4-3 in a penalty shootout?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NorthEast United FC**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **NorthEast United FC won the Durand Cup 2024 by defeating Mohun Bagan Super Giant 4-3 in a penalty shootout at the Salt Lake Stadium, Kolkata.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Mohun Bagan had a 2-0 lead in the first half with goals from** Jason Cummings (penalty) and Sahal Abdul Samad.**
 
• NorthEast United equalized with goals from** Alaaeddine Ajaraie and Guillermo Fernandez** in the second half.
 
• The match went directly to penalty shootouts after regulation time.
 
• **Gurmeet Singh, NorthEast United’s goalkeeper,** made two crucial saves during the shootout, denying Liston Colaco and Subhasish Bose.
 
• This is **NorthEast United's first Durand Cup** win since their inception 10 years ago.
 
• **Jithin M.S.** was awarded the Golden Ball for providing the most assists in the tournament.
